textual_summary: Executive briefing summary for Rolls-Royce leadership. Macro trends highlight energy-security chokepoints and trade integration in West Asia, with India navigating Iran’s docking requests, Hormuz passage exemptions, and rapid EU-India FTA implementation. Civil sector momentum shows continued U.S. manufacturing investments and India-facing tech expansion by Airbus and Embraer, offset by West Asia aviation disruptions stressing contingency routing. Defence landscape maps India-France FCAS collaboration, AMCA advances, and a broad push toward self-reliance through Make in India, defence startups, and domestic industrial bases, alongside a rising arms-import stance per SIPRI data. PowerSystems currently has no new items in this window. SMR/Nuclear developments articulate a thorium-led path to 100 GWe by 2047 via SHANTI-enabled reform, HALEU-thorium fuel cycles, and SMR/TMSR opportunities, signaling a strategic pivot toward energy security, proliferation resistance, and defense-industrial scalability. Overall, the dossier emphasizes resilience, capacity scaling, and the tightening of international partnerships and domestic capability in aerospace, defence, and critical energy systems.
